authorizationText: 授权排名、赢家判定、综合评分
weightPreferenceText: 更重视延迟与运行开销
analysisTiming: Additional ranking and decision analysis defined after the existing endpoint results were available; not preregistered
eligibility: All existing correctness, measurement and accepted-data gates must remain valid
weightChoice: Analyst operationalization of the user's latency/operating-cost priority; not individually selected by the user
endpointInputs: Frozen fixed-effect reference linear predictors for D1-D4 and frozen D1-GM per-log2-axis slopes for D5-D7
direction: Lower is preferred for every endpoint and slope
normalization: Within the fixed six-algorithm cohort, rank lower values first with midranks for numerical ties; utility = 100*(6-rank)/5
aggregation: D1 utility is the arithmetic mean of its two component utilities; composite score is the weighted arithmetic mean of all seven domain utilities
interpretation: A relative 0-100 rank-based utility score, not a percentage speedup, pass rate or probability; effect magnitude is reported separately
pointWinner: Eligible algorithm(s) with the maximum unrounded primary composite score; ties remain ties
uncertainty: Recompute two-sided Bonferroni simultaneous model-scale intervals for all 120 primitive all-pair contrasts at familywise alpha=0.05 using the frozen normal-z standard errors; derive conservative population-rank and weighted-score bounds from the simultaneously established ordering relations

allPairFamily.pCorrection: Holm over 105 two-sided composites; D1 composite p is the maximum of its two component p values

domainWinner: Requires the same algorithm to be lower than every other algorithm on every component of that domain, with all relevant global simultaneous intervals below zero and global Holm composite p < 0.05
statisticallySeparatedScoreWinner: Requires the point winner's conservative score lower bound to exceed the score upper bound of every other algorithm; otherwise no uniquely separated score winner
globalDominanceWinner: Requires a statistically supported win against every algorithm in every domain; otherwise none

sensitivity.runtimeGroupWeightSweep: rho from 0 to 1; D1:D2:D3 fixed at 7:4:3; D4-D7 each (1-rho)/4; calculate exact upper-envelope crossover locations
sensitivity.weightPerturbations: All 128 corners of independent 0.5x/1.5x primary-weight multipliers followed by renormalization; report scenario counts, not probabilities
sensitivity.leaveOneDomainOut: Set each domain weight to zero in turn and renormalize the rest

figureContract.question: Which algorithm leads under the stated runtime priority and how stable is that decision?
panels: Primary scores and conservative simultaneous bounds
